async def act(page):
    # Try to dismiss any blocking popup/dialog first by scoping to dialog/alertdialog
    for role in ("dialog", "alertdialog"):
        dlg = page.get_by_role(role)
        if await dlg.count() > 0:
            d0 = dlg.nth(0)
            # Try several common close button names scoped to the dialog
            for name in ["Close", "close", "×", "X", "Dismiss", "dismiss"]:
                btn = d0.get_by_role("button", name=name)
                if await btn.count() > 0:
                    await btn.click()
                    await page.wait_for_timeout(250)
                    break
            else:
                # If no named button, try the first button inside the dialog
                if await d0.get_by_role("button").count() > 0:
                    await d0.get_by_role("button").nth(0).click()
                    await page.wait_for_timeout(250)
            break

    # Additionally try page-level close buttons as a fallback
    for name in ["Close", "close", "×", "X", "Dismiss", "dismiss"]:
        btn = page.get_by_role("button", name=name)
        if await btn.count() > 0:
            await btn.click()
            await page.wait_for_timeout(250)
            break

    # Press Escape as a last-ditch dismiss
    try:
        await page.keyboard.press("Escape")
        await page.wait_for_timeout(200)
    except Exception:
        pass

    # Now scope to the complementary region (sidebar) which contains the Archives widget
    complementary = page.get_by_role("complementary")
    if await complementary.count() == 0:
        # Fallback: try a page-level link lookup for December 2017
        page_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="December 2017")
        if await page_link.count() > 0:
            await page_link.click()
        return

    sidebar = complementary.nth(0)

    # Try a direct, scoped lookup for the December 2017 link and click it
    dec_link = sidebar.get_by_role("link", name="December 2017")
    if await dec_link.count() > 0:
        await dec_link.click()
        return

    # Fallback: iterate links inside the sidebar and click the one whose visible text contains 'December 2017'
    links = sidebar.get_by_role("link")
    total = await links.count()
    for i in range(total):
        try:
            txt = (await links.nth(i).inner_text()).strip()
        except Exception:
            continue
        if "December 2017" in txt:
            await links.nth(i).click()
            return

    # Final fallback: page-level lookup
    page_level = page.get_by_role("link", name="December 2017")
    if await page_level.count() > 0:
        await page_level.click()
        return

    # If nothing found, return silently
    return
